question: Should WhatsApp expose temporary per-group listen windows as a supported activation/configuration contract in addition to `mention` and `always`?
rationale: This is a new user-facing channel-policy mode, not a repair to an established behavior, and it changes when authorized group messages reach an agent.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded mode
options.body: Accept the opt-in group configuration after a maintainer confirms the desired semantics and the contributor supplies live authorized-group evidence.

options.title: Retain existing activation modes
options.body: Decline the added configuration contract and continue supporting only the existing `mention` and `always` choices.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded mode
recommendation.body: Accept the opt-in group configuration after a maintainer confirms the desired semantics and the contributor supplies live authorized-group evidence.
